intro.Subject: Subject of Amos: Jehovah's Judgments on Israel and the Surrounding Nations, with the Issue of Restoration
intro.Author: Amos (1:1a).
intro.Place of His Ministry: Bethel, in the northern kingdom of Israel (7:13).

verses.text: And their king will go into captivity, He and his princes together, Says Jehovah.
verses.marked_text: And their king will go into captivity, He and his princes together, Says Jehovah.

footnotes.text: Meaning burden bearer. The central thought of Amos’s prophecy, which is nearly the same as that of Hosea and Joel, is that Jehovah punishes the nations and chastises Israel that the age of restoration ( Matt. 19:28 ) may be brought in for the kingdom of David ( Amos 9:11-12 ; Acts 15:15-16 ) — the kingdom of Christ ( Rev. 11:15 ).

The words Because of three transgressions…indeed, because of four indicate repeated transgressions, which were the cause of God’s judgments on Judah and Israel and on the surrounding nations. So throughout chs. 1—2.
Lit., it. So throughout the book.
Or, vanity; referring to idols.
I.e., Syria.

Ammon and Moab ( Amos 2:1 ) were sons of Lot by incest ( Gen. 19:30-38 ).

Ref: Jer. 49:1-6 ; Ezek. 25:2-7 ; Zeph. 2:9

verses.text: Only you have I known Of all the families of the earth; Therefore I will visit upon you All your iniquities.
verses.marked_text: Only you have I known Of all the families of the earth; Therefore I will visit upon you All your iniquities.

verses.marked_text: Will<fn n="1"/> two walk together If they have not met at an appointed place?

verses.text: Will the lion roar in the forest When he has no prey? Will a young lion utter his voice from his den If he has not seized anything?
verses.marked_text: Will the lion roar in the forest When he has no prey? Will a young lion utter his voice from his den If he has not seized anything?

verses.text: Will a bird fall into a trap on the earth When there is no snare laid for it? Will a trap spring up off the ground When it has seized nothing at all?
verses.marked_text: Will a bird fall into a trap on the earth When there is no snare laid for it? Will a trap spring up off the ground When it has seized nothing at all?

verses.marked_text: Can a trumpet be blown in a city And the people not dread? Can there be ill in a city And Jehovah did not do it?

verses.marked_text: Surely the Lord Jehovah will not do anything unless He reveals His secret to His servants the prophets.

verses.text: For in the day when I visit The transgressions of Israel upon him, I will visit the altars of Bethel, And the horns of the altar will be cut off And will fall to the ground.

verses.text: And I will strike the winter house Along with the summer house; And the houses of ivory will perish, And many houses will come to an end, Declares Jehovah.
verses.marked_text: And I will strike the winter<fn n="1"/> house Along with the summer<fn n="1"/> house; And the houses of ivory will perish, And many houses will come to an end, Declares Jehovah.

footnotes.text: Verses 3-8 indicate that the cause of Jehovah’s visitation (punishment) was that Israel was not one with God. They had their own intention, goal, and purpose, and God had His. But God revealed all His secrets to His prophets ( v. 7 ). Israel, therefore, should have listened to the prophets.
Bethel had become a place for the worship of idols ( 1 Kings 12:25-33 ).

The winter house and the summer house were luxurious retreat houses. Here, such houses and the worship of idols are regarded as one thing. Those who went to the retreat houses for enjoyment were also those who worshipped idols at the altars of Bethel.

verses.text: And I also have given you Cleanness of teeth in all your cities And want of bread in all your places. Yet you have not returned to Me, Declares Jehovah.
verses.marked_text: And I also have given you Cleanness of teeth in all your cities And want of bread in all your places. Yet you have not returned to Me, Declares Jehovah.

verses.text: And I have also withheld the rain from you When there was yet three months until the harvest; And I made it rain on one city, But on another city I did not make it rain; One portion was rained on, And the portion that was not rained on dried up.

verses.text: And two or three cities wandered to one city to drink water, But they were not satisfied. Yet you have not returned to Me, Declares Jehovah.
verses.marked_text: And two or three cities wandered to one city to drink water, But they were not satisfied. Yet you have not returned to Me, Declares Jehovah.

verses.text: I have stricken you with blight and mildew; The multitudes of your gardens and your vineyards, And your fig trees and your olive trees, the cutting locust has devoured. Yet you have not returned to Me, Declares Jehovah.
verses.marked_text: I have stricken you with blight and mildew; The multitudes of your gardens and your vineyards, And your fig trees and your olive trees, the cutting locust has devoured. Yet you have not returned to Me, Declares Jehovah.

verses.text: I have sent among you pestilence after the manner of Egypt; I have slain your choice young men with the sword, taking your horses captive; And I have caused the stench of your camp to go up even into your own nostrils. Yet you have not returned to Me, Declares Jehovah.

verses.text: I have overturned cities among you, As when God overturned Sodom and Gomorrah; And you were like a brand plucked out of the burning. Yet you have not returned to Me, Declares Jehovah.
verses.marked_text: I have overturned cities among you, As when God overturned Sodom and Gomorrah; And you were like a brand plucked out of the burning. Yet you have not returned to Me, Declares Jehovah.

verses.text: Therefore this is what I will do to you, O Israel; And because I will do this to you, Prepare to meet your God, O Israel.
verses.marked_text: Therefore this is what I will do to you, O Israel; And because I will do this to you, Prepare<fn n="1"/> to meet your God, O Israel.

verses.text: For it is He who forms the mountains and creates the wind And declares to man what His thought is; He who makes the morning darkness And treads upon the high places of the earth — Jehovah the God of hosts is His name!
verses.marked_text: For it is He who forms the mountains and creates the wind And declares to man what His thought is; He who makes the morning darkness And treads upon the high places of the earth — Jehovah the God of hosts is His name!

footnotes.text:
In vv. 6-13 the prophet speaks regarding Jehovah’s punishment with the expectation of Israel’s returning to Jehovah and their preparing to meet Him who is the Creator and Ruler of all things.

Ref: cf. Ezek. 13:5 ; 22:30 ; Luke 14:31-32

verses.text: Hear this word that I take up as a lamentation over you, O house of Israel.
verses.marked_text: Hear this word that I take up as a lamentation over you, O house of Israel.

verses.text: Fallen and no more to rise Is the virgin of Israel; She has been cast down upon her land; There is none to raise her up.
verses.marked_text: Fallen and no more to rise Is the virgin of Israel; She has been cast down upon her land; There is none to raise her up.

verses.text: For thus says the Lord Jehovah, The city that sent forth a thousand Will have a hundred left, And that which sent forth a hundred Will have ten left, To the house of Israel.
verses.marked_text: For thus says the Lord Jehovah, The city that sent forth a thousand Will have a hundred left, And that which sent forth a hundred Will have ten left, To the house of Israel.

verses.text: For thus says Jehovah to the house of Israel, Seek Me, and live;
verses.marked_text: For thus says Jehovah to the house of Israel, Seek Me, and live;

verses.text: And do not seek Bethel, Nor go to Gilgal, Nor pass on to Beer-sheba; For Gilgal will surely go into captivity, And Bethel will become vanity.
verses.marked_text: And do not seek Bethel, Nor go to Gilgal, Nor pass on to Beer-sheba; For Gilgal will surely go into captivity, And Bethel will become vanity.

verses.text: Seek Jehovah, and live; Lest He rush upon the house of Joseph like fire, And it devour it, and there be none to extinguish the fire in Bethel.
verses.marked_text: Seek Jehovah, and live; Lest He rush upon the house of Joseph like fire, And it devour it, and there be none to extinguish the fire in Bethel.

verses.text: They turn justice to wormwood And thrust righteousness down to the ground.
verses.marked_text: They turn justice to wormwood And thrust righteousness down to the ground.

verses.text: He who makes the Pleiades and Orion And turns the shadow of death into the morning And darkens the day with the night; He who calls for the water of the sea And pours it upon the surface of the earth, Jehovah is His name,
verses.marked_text: He who makes the Pleiades and Orion And turns the shadow of death into the morning And darkens the day with the night; He who calls for the water of the sea And pours it upon the surface of the earth, Jehovah is His name,

verses.marked_text: Who causes destruction to flash forth upon the strong, So that destruction comes upon the fortress.

verses.text: They hate him who reproves in the gate, And him who speaks with integrity they abhor.
verses.marked_text: They hate him who reproves in the gate<fn n="1"/>, And him who speaks with integrity they abhor.

verses.text: Therefore because you trample upon the poor And take a forced gift of wheat from them; You have built houses of hewn stone, But you will not dwell in them; You have planted desirable vineyards, But you will not drink their wine.

verses.marked_text: For I know that your transgressions are many And that your sins are mighty, You who vex the righteous and take ransom<fn n="1"/> payment And turn aside justice for the needy in the gate.

verses.text: Therefore thus says Jehovah, The God of hosts, the Lord: In all the open plazas there will be wailing, And in all the streets they will say, Alas! Alas! And they will call the farmer to mourning, And for wailing to those skilled in lamentation.

In His chastising of Israel the sinful nation, God would cause them to suffer but would not allow them to be utterly destroyed, because He has a purpose. For the purpose of His incarnation God had to preserve a remnant of Israel.

David is a type of Christ as the King. The tabernacle of David is the kingdom of David and the royal family of David. That kingdom, that royal family, fell when Nebuchadnezzar came to capture the nation of Israel, devastate the land, burn the city, destroy the temple, and carry off the king ( 2 Kings 25:1-21 ). In Amos’s prophecy God promised that in a certain day the kingdom of David and the family of David would be restored, and all the nations would be called by the name of Jehovah. This prophecy indicates that Christ will come back to be the real David ( Isa. 9:7 ; 16:5 ; Jer. 30:9 ; Ezek. 34:23-24 ; 37:24-25 ; Hosea 3:5 ) and will rebuild, i.e., restore, the kingdom of His forefather David for the restoration of the entire universe. At that time the kingdom of David will become the kingdom of Christ and of God for eternity ( Rev. 11:15 ). In the restored kingdom all the nations will be called by the name of Jehovah; i.e., all the nations will belong to God. Amos’s prophecy in vv. 11-12 was quoted by James in Acts 15:16-18 to confirm Peter’s and Paul’s going to the Gentiles, because in the restoration all the Gentiles will become God’s people, just as the Jews are.

Ref: Isa. 16:5
